title: Calibrated Bitwidth Sanity & Fidelity Signature Harness
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Build an automated harness that executes calibration workflows across candidate bitwidth profiles (FP8, INT8 and hybrid mixes), computes a compact fidelity signature for each profile, and evaluates pass/fail gates against production-weighted prompt cohorts. This harness will be the canonical acceptance check used by model-on-serve rollouts (canary A/B and full promotion).

Background: We frequently ship quantized variants for cost savings; existing tests either measure raw token-level divergence or run ad-hoc human evals. We need a reproducible, CI-friendly pipeline that: 1) runs deterministic calibration steps (per-layer scale, activation clipping, bias compensation), 2) replays curated prompt cohorts (including long-context sequences and adversarial perturbations), 3) computes a small set of robust metrics and a composite fidelity signature, and 4) emits pass/fail decisions plus actionable telemetry for developers and SREs.

Goals:
- Provide single-command CI job to validate a quantized candidate against a baseline float model.
- Produce a human-readable artifact (JSON) containing metric breakdowns, cohort-level deltas, and a compact fidelity signature token.
- Integrate with Console SLO alerts and rollout gate APIs so that failing candidates are automatically blocked from canary promotion.
- Support extensible metric plugin hooks (e.g., TopK-consistency, Token-Fidelity, length-preservation-delta).
acceptance_criteria: Can run calibration + eval end-to-end in CI within 45 minutes for baseline 1B-3B models using a 4x GPU test node
Produces fidelity_signature (base64 short digest) and per-cohort metric table in JSON artifact
Pass/fail gate computed using composite-fidelity-score with configurable thresholds per project
Console dashboard ingestable telemetry (per-token latency, validation-cost, metric deltas) available via /dashboards/quant-fidelity

Integration tests that simulate: a) INT8 candidate that meets thresholds, b) FP8 candidate that fails on Token-Fidelity but passes TopK-consistency, c) hybrid candidate that marginally fails and triggers human review workflow
implementation_steps: Design fidelity_signature format and hashing scheme (include upstream-model-hash, eval-seed, cohort-id)
Implement calibration runner: hooks for per-layer scale calibration, activation histogram matching, bias-aware compensation
Create cohort runner: canonical prompt sets + generator that can produce perturbations (truncation, stop-token injection, synthetic typos)
Metric library: implement Token-Fidelity, TopK-consistency, Sequence-ROUGE-lite (length-preservation-delta), and composite-fidelity-score with weights configurable per project
Pass/fail gate engine: accept thresholds config, emit detailed failure reasons and suggested mitigations
CI integration: GitHub Actions job template + caching for downloaded models and golden prompts
Console integration: telemetry schema, dashboard proto, and rollout-gate webhook for automatic blocking
End-to-end tests and synthetic adversarial scenarios for regression coverage
progress_updates: 2026-01-12: Initial design doc reviewed by ML infra and Platform (PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Calibrated+Bitwidth+Harness)
2026-01-27: Prototype calibration runner implemented (per-layer scale, histogram match). Local smoke runs on a 2xA100 test node producing reproducible activation statistics
2026-02-09: Cohort curator delivered: 12 curated prompt families + adversarial perturbation generator. Seeded with product prompts and open-source corpora
2026-02-24: Metric library alpha implemented. Early results show TopK-consistency correlates with human judgments on sample 500 prompt subset
2026-03-02: Decided composite-fidelity-score weighting: default weights Token-Fidelity 0.5, TopK-consistency 0.3, Length-preservation-delta 0.2 (configurable per project)
2026-03-10: CI job template up in dev repo (https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-harness/pull/88). Running full pipeline currently takes ~40 minutes on the dev infra after caching improvements
decisions: Use a compact signature (SHA256 then base64-URL shorten) to fingerprint candidate results — allows quick diffs in the Console
Treat Token-Fidelity as primary signal for gating because it best correlates with user-visible degradations in prior audits
Keep gating thresholds project-configurable; default to conservative values for customer-facing runtimes (runtime-1.25) and more permissive for experimental dev clusters
Do not bake in absolute token-match metrics (exact-match) — favor distributional measures to tolerate expected sampling variance in generation
notes: Edge-case observed: FP8 candidates occasionally pass composite score but have localized hallucination on long-context QA prompts — plan to add cohort-specific heuristics to increase sensitivity for long-context cohorts
We should consider running a small stochastic-sampling bucket (n=5 seeds) for candidates near the threshold to surface variance before gating
Telemetry payloads must include calibration artifacts (layer scales) truncated to avoid PII and reduce payload size
Coordinate with SRE to ensure validation jobs are account-billed to the CI umbrella project to avoid noisy cost attribution
next_steps: Merge PR #88 and enable GitHub Action for the runtime-1.25 branch as opt-in for model release PRs
Add cohort sensitivity tuning UI to Console: allow engineers to increase/decrease weight per-cohort for composite score
Implement stochastic-sampling mode and a 'variance check' that requires human review when variance > configured threshold
Ship telemetry schema and small dashboard prototype to product for review by 2026-03-20
Schedule cross-team demo with Platform, ML Infra, and SRE to align rollout gating behavior (target 2026-03-25)
